mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_finance_posting WHERE id = #{postingId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM xsy_finance_posting_void WHERE posting_id = #{postingId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_finance_posting_void (posting_id, reason, voided_at, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{postingId}, #{reason}, #{voidedAt}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (posting_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT c.seller_id FROM xsy_finance_posting p JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = p.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.id = #{postingId} AND p.deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS postingId, p.posting_no AS postingNo, p.customer_id AS customerId, p.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, p.settlement_customer_id AS settlementCustomerId, p.settlement_customer_name_snapshot AS settlementCustomerName, p.document_date AS documentDate, p.amount, p.tax_rate AS taxRate, p.refund_status AS refundStatus, p.remark, CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'VOIDED' END AS status, v.voided_at AS voidedAt, v.created_by AS voidedBy, v.reason AS voidReason, p.version, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.created_by AS createdBy, p.updated_by AS updatedBy FROM xsy_finance_posting p LEFT JOIN xsy_finance_posting_void v ON v.posting_id = p.id AND v.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = p.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE
